requirements.title: LOGICAL_KINDS lists supported logical kinds and has required array shape
requirements.definition: LOGICAL_KINDS is a default integer rank-one array constant whose values are exactly the processor-supported logical kind values; its lower bound is one and its size is the number of supported logical kinds.

pending.LOGICAL_KINDS-supported-kind-set: Use LOGICAL_KINDS with concrete probes LOGICAL(KIND=LOGICAL_KINDS(1)) and default LOGICAL .TRUE.; assert ANY(LOGICAL_KINDS==KIND(.TRUE.)), SIZE(LOGICAL_KINDS)>=1, and generated declarations for each LOGICAL_KINDS element compile. Mutate the array name to REAL_KINDS.
pending.LOGICAL_KINDS-rank-lower-bound-and-size: Assert RANK(LOGICAL_KINDS)==1, LBOUND(LOGICAL_KINDS,1)==1, and SIZE(LOGICAL_KINDS)>=1 using integer sentinels -777 for each observed value. Mutate the expected lower bound to zero.
